Resolves #21385

The web desktop now says what it is. `Neo.desktop.Taskbar` shows the time over the date at its right end, in the app's locale, and moves them on every full minute; the time is desktop chrome, so the engine holds one clock and no consumer writes a timer. `examples/desktop/basic` and `apps/webdesktop` each put their product's name on the wallpaper and a card beside the launcher that says what the screen is, through the workspace's items by key, with no engine change for either.

Evidence: L3 (a unit arm for the clock; live Chromium frames of `dev` and of this head; a cold look) → L3 required (AC-1 unit, AC-2 and AC-3 frames, AC-4 cold look, AC-5 suites). Residual: none.

Change class: capability (`feat`). agent-preflight: not hosted here; the pre-commit and pre-push guards ran.

## Cold look

Readers without context, one at a time, each saw one neo-dark frame of the example and answered #21348's three questions: what is this screen, how much does it look like a finished product a visitor would trust (1 to 10), and what is its weakest point.

| Frame | What it is, in their words | Grade | Weakest point |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dev` (control) | "a desktop-style home screen (an OS or web-desktop shell)" | 4 | "no branding, title, clock, status area … no sign of what this product is for" |
| this head | "the home screen of 'Neo Desktop', a web desktop demo built with Neo.mjs" | 5 | the empty middle: no open window, no cue to click |
| this head | "the home screen of 'Neo Desktop', a web desktop demo built with Neo.mjs" | 5 | the empty wallpaper, the faint watermark and the small, pale card text |
| this head | "the 'Neo Desktop' home screen, a dark teal-to-navy web desktop" | 5 | the empty centre, a small low-contrast card, a nearly invisible watermark |

All three after readers name the product unprompted (AC-4 asks for two of three), and the grade moves from 4 to 5. Their shared weakest point, an empty middle with no open window, is #21353's to answer: real apps, and windows a visitor opens. The card's contrast and the watermark's faintness are noted for the design pass after the lock.
